name: coremodel
description: Spends only what each prompt needs: picks the model and effort level, and asks before the costly ones.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto: switch by itself, with an undo; ask only before Fable, Extra high, Max and a stronger model mid-chat. suggest: never ask; offer the pick above the prompt, you press to switch. off: do nothing.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of CoreModel's words: auto follows Claude Code's language setting (Russian for russian or ru, else English), or pick one.

classifier.title: Classifier model
classifier.description: The model that reads each prompt and picks the model and level: sonnet (more accurate) or haiku (faster, cheaper).

useHaiku.title: Allow Haiku
useHaiku.description: May CoreModel pick Haiku? Untick it to never use Haiku. A model your account does not have is never picked anyway.

useSonnet.title: Allow Sonnet
useSonnet.description: May CoreModel pick Sonnet? Untick it to never use Sonnet. A model your account does not have is never picked anyway.

useOpus.title: Allow Opus
useOpus.description: May CoreModel pick Opus? Untick it to never use Opus. A model your account does not have is never picked anyway.

useFable.title: Allow Fable
useFable.description: May CoreModel pick Fable? Untick it to never use Fable. A model your account does not have is never picked anyway.

pickModel.title: Pick the model
pickModel.description: on: pick the model and the effort. off: pick the effort level only, never the model.
